title: Fleet Fuel Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Set the fleet fuel inspection scope, test readiness and requirement-level evidence, contain deficiencies, authorize status, and preserve qualified closeout.
description: An original, fillable fleet fuel inspection checklist form for controlling bulk or mobile fleet-fuel delivery and tank inventory through inspection checklist identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use when a fuel dispatch or fleet coordinator or qualified inspector must evaluate bulk or mobile fleet-fuel delivery and tank inventory against the fuel order, product record, tank chart, meter ticket, and site procedure and provide a traceable basis for release, restriction, hold, correction, or rejection.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Define the exact population and review basis so inspection conclusions remain bounded.

fields.label: Bulk Or Mobile Fleet-Fuel Delivery And Tank Inventory
Fuel Order, Product Record, Tank Chart, Meter Ticket, And Site Procedure

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel readiness verification
items: Fuel grade, quantity, destination tank, and available capacity are verified
Driver, vehicle, compartment, placard, seal, and meter identities are recorded
Tank, fill point, vent, overfill control, and site authorization are confirmed
Transfer hose, bonding or grounding, caps, fittings, and containment are ready
Ignition sources, smoking, traffic, public access, and weather hazards are controlled
Extinguisher, spill kit, emergency stop, and notification route are available
Starting gauge, water check, meter reading, and product compatibility are documented
Stop-work, spill, wrong-product, overfill, leak, and rejected-load paths are explicit
blocks.guidance: A failed readiness item must be resolved, excluded with rationale, or carried into the exception section.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel requirement-level inspection results
sections.guidance: Record actual observations against explicit criteria and identify the evidence for each result.

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel detailed inspection points
items: Fuel order, product grade, destination tank, and fill-point label agree
Tank available capacity supports the planned delivery with operating margin
Compartment, seal, meter, hose, nozzle, fitting, and cap identities are traceable
No leak, damage, loose connection, blocked vent, or containment defect is visible
Ignition, smoking, traffic, pedestrian, and unauthorized-access controls are active
Bonding or grounding and static-control steps follow the applicable site procedure
Extinguisher, spill response equipment, emergency stop, and communication are accessible
Starting gauge, water check, meter start, and product appearance are acceptable
Transfer remains attended and observations can be recorded throughout delivery
Any wrong-product, leak, spill, capacity, fire, or unsafe-site concern stops transfer
blocks.guidance: Checkboxes indicate that the point was examined; the result table carries findings and evidence.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel measurements and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings, instruments, identity, and evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, count, or verification log
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to Ordered, metered, corrected, and accepted volume and Tank, hose, fitting, containment, and product condition.

blocks.label: Available inspection evidence
items: Fuel order and supplier loading record
Compartment, seal, and product identity
Destination tank label and starting gauge
Meter start, meter end, and delivery ticket
Water check, product observation, or sample reference
Transfer start, stop, and attendant record
Spill, leak, overfill, or emergency response record
Receiver acceptance and inventory posting reference

blocks.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

fields.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

sections.title: Fleet Fuel exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Fleet Fuel exception indicators
items: Wrong fuel grade, destination tank, or fill point
Insufficient tank capacity or unreliable gauge
Broken seal, product appearance concern, or water indication
Leak, loose fitting, damaged hose, cap, vent, or containment
Spill, overfill, fire, vapor, static, or ignition-source concern
Meter failure or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
Unauthorized person, vehicle movement, or uncontrolled site access
Emergency stop, extinguisher, spill kit, or communication unavailable
Receiver refuses product, quantity, or condition
Environmental, safety, or site notification remains incomplete
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Fleet Fuel inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Do not turn a checklist score into release when a critical exception or evidence gap remains.

fields.label: Qualified Fuel Operations And Environmental Safety Lead review

sections.title: Fleet Fuel inspection checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This fleet fuel inspection checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, contract terms, safety or product requirements, or professional judgment. Stop the affected movement, transfer, release, posting, or disposition when identity, evidence, authorization, or control is uncertain. A qualified qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead must review the exception and document the controlling decision.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by qualified fuel operations and environmental safety lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
